svg.aria-label: Jano: your repo, explained before a word is read. At the top of a README, Jano draws a poster part by part; build.py measures it (text size, contrast, loop, speed, file size) and writes hero-dark.svg and hero-light.svg.

text.tspan: An agent skill that draws your README a looping
SVG poster, dark and light, measured on every build.
